From A to Z: your guide to your degree
You are here:Doctor of natural sciences
Doctor of Natural Sciences
If you have a degree in a natural science and your supervisor has a Dr. rer. nat. in addition to the right to supervise, then the Dr. rer. nat. doctorate is suitable for you.
Doctor of natural sciences
If you have a Master's or equivalent degree in a natural science and if you are supervised by a member of the LMU Faculty of Medicine who is authorized to supervise and who holds the title Dr. rer. nat. themselves, then the Dr. rer. nat. could be the right choice for you
The supervision of Dr. rer. nat. projects
Dr. rer. nat. projects can only be supervised by faculty members who hold the title Dr. rer. nat.
Read more
Acceptance of applications for the Dr. rer. nat.
Before starting your doctoral project, you must complete an application for admission as a doctoral candidate.
Read more
Submission of your dissertation
You submit your thesis and some forms electronically and in print to the Doctoral Office.
Read more
The evaluation of your dissertation
Each dissertation is evaluated by 6 experts.
Read more
The defense of your thesis
The defense is a scientific discussion with your examination committee.
Read more
Publication of the statutory copies and the doctoral certificate
You will receive your doctoral certificate after you have published your statutory copies.
